name: Брок
notes:
Брок, one of the two accusers at Грог's trial in Kragmir (Session 10 arrest). A clanless dock dwarf in Гвоздь's pay. On the night of Session 10 he and Тамм posed as undercover guards, offered Грог 15 gold to help break into a port warehouse, and were taken down by him: Брок got the butt of an axe under the knee. The knee never set right. He walks on an iron-shod crutch at half a dwarf's pace and plays the cripple loudly for any audience.

In court he is the loud one: he shows the knee, tells the story of an honest worker beaten for nothing, and lies with conviction. The truth (GM): the pair were opening a smuggling store for Гвоздь in the port, and Брок does not yet know that Гвоздь's crew died in the warehouse the night before the trial.

In a fight he can't keep up, so he brings enemies down to him: a hooked aklys on a cord that pulls legs out from under people, crutch hooks, and a clan dagger once everyone is on the floor. If he loses the crutch he falls. He counts as one of Гвоздь's bought men for Bought Men.

actions.name: Knee for a Knee
actions.text:
Брок hooks a creature's legs with his crutch and throws his whole weight after it. He makes a crutch Strike against an adjacent creature.

Critical Success The target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]. Брок keeps his feet.

Success The target is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone], and Брок falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone] beside it.

Failure Брок falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone].

actions.name: Smashed Knee
actions.text:
An axe butt under the knee left Брок lame. His Speed already includes the injury. He can't Leap, and when he is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone], Stand takes him 2 actions instead of 1.

Without his crutch in hand he falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone] and can only Crawl until he picks it up again.

actions.name: Fights from the Floor
actions.text: Брок spends half his fights on the ground and has learned to strike from there. He gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Strike attack rolls while he is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone], which cancels the penalty for being prone.

actions.name: Look What He Did to Me
actions.text: While Брок shows his ruined knee to an audience, he gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to [[/act lie]]{Lie} and to Performance checks.
